correctness.rationale: At a positive fixed point of the printed Gaussian moment map, the first component gives s=mu(1-1/r-mu), so at r=113/100 biological feasibility requires 0<mu<13/113, immediately excluding the reported value near 0.33. The source's quartic equilibrium equation can be bounded uniformly on that whole interval: dropping the negative terms and maximizing the positive monomials at the endpoint gives H below 292201/22600000, while rv=226/15625 exceeds this by the exact positive gap 173427/113000000. Thus no feasible positive fixed point exists at the printed pair, not merely the rounded displayed one. An independent exact-rational replay also reproduces the rounded-point mean residual -16167/200000.
